contentPattern: Two leading single-cell rows hold block-level content: row 1 intro (rich text, usually the section heading; may be empty), row 2 cta (rich text, e.g. 'Baixe o app' text plus App Store / Google Play badge links, or a button; may be empty). Every following row is one slide with two cells: (1) media - an image and/or a link to a video file (mp4/webm), which becomes a muted looping inline video; (2) content - rich text: the step description, or for the vertical options a heading, text and an optional button. Only the active slide's cells are shown; slides auto-advance with dots and a pause/play toggle. The vertical options (vertical, vertical-2, vertical-purple-light) move the controls into a right-hand column with up/down arrows.
reuseGuidance: Use for sequential app steps or short feature showcases (3-6 slides) with one media item per slide. Default and the colour options (light-grey-purple, orange-grey-purple) keep a shared heading in the intro row; vertical options usually leave intro empty and put the heading in each slide. For plain image galleries use another carousel.
usageDescription: Step-by-step 'how it works in the app' slideshow: a fixed heading on the left, a step description that changes per slide, an app screen photo or video on the right, dot pagination with pause, and an app-download CTA. The vertical options are a product showcase that steps vertically with up/down arrows, each slide carrying its own heading, text and button.
